source: Department for Transport, STATS19 road safety open data
local_acquisition_note: Original retrieval time was not recorded. Validation dates are not download dates. Input byte identity is recorded by SHA-256 in Bronze run reports.
scope: Police-reported personal injury collisions on public roads in Great Britain
refresh: Final annual data; provisional mid-year releases are separate. This project processes a fixed local snapshot.
licence: Open Government Licence v3.0, except where otherwise stated on the source page
attribution: Contains public sector information licensed under the Open Government Licence v3.0. Source: Department for Transport.
reproducibility_note: Last-five-years URLs are mutable. Preserve the local raw files externally and compare SHA-256 values. The current guide URL does not establish the download origin of the local guide; its hash identifies the guide actually used.
